verdict.sourceLightComponent: BOUNDED_PASS for the inspected source-local wash and ten isolated raster cases.
verdict.wholeComposition: HOLD: current default-size receipt ink intersects ceiling badge 4 at both viewports. AX5 captures additionally do not establish settled complete-reader/footer composition.
verdict.overallGoal: Not adopted by this review. Native current-story comparison and other coordinator gates remain separate; component success cannot override the visible current failure.

independence: The reviewer inspected source-bound whole PNGs against the approved Play concept before receiving an implementer candidate visual verdict. Mechanical success did not determine the visual judgment.

source.runtimeQualification: Exact checkpoint/build ID recorded in the coordinator commands and stage receipt; this review did not inspect installed binary metadata or run another build.

hostedRun.scope: Fourteen hosted methods passed. This independent visual review covers only the twenty crowded whole frames and ten isolated source-light specimens, not every attachment from the fourteen methods.

approvedReference.role: Direction for board dominance, continuous scenery, restrained instruments and distinguishable playable stars; concept is not runtime or exact-layout evidence.
approvedReference.comparison: The local source wash preserves the star-field focus and leaves distant choices distinct. The observed receipt/ceiling overlap fails independent hierarchy and fact legibility despite the otherwise related Observatory materials.

fixture.wholeScreenKind: Real production FallingSkyView/store/SpriteKit in hosted UIWindow; deterministic saved survival-history fixture, not a native XCTest current Story journey, mockup or isolated renderer.

history.occupancyQualification: Exact values come from passed fixture assertions/Core state. Every reviewed whole PNG is visibly star-bearing; this review does not independently pixel-count all occupied cells in every clipped/scrolling frame.

fixture.normalMotion: Fixture requires actual system Reduce Motion off, calmEffects false and scene.reduceMotion false. ManualRainClock prevents automatic schedule races; the production presenter/receipt runs with normal motion.

phaseSampling.before: Captured after sceneReady and unsuspended; no explicit stable painted-placement assertion.
phaseSampling.phase-0: First capture at event age >= 0.18 seconds.
phaseSampling.phase-1: First capture at event age >= 0.65 seconds.
phaseSampling.phase-2: First capture at event age >= 1.1 seconds.
phaseSampling.limit: Thresholds are source facts, not exact attached event ages. Capture timestamps do not establish continuous motion or exact age.

fixture.isolatedCases: Ten fixed-age black-Canvas specimens call only production drawSourceLight. Six positive cases include translated/scrolled mapping and four independent protected slots; four negative cases cover ordinary, quiet, before-release and expired. White/black bottom readiness marker is test-only, not product decoration.

findings.observation: Default and AX5 visible source areas retain a subtle local left wash; distant right-side stars and fixed score/forecast remain distinguishable. The active packet/pulse shapes are separate existing effects and are not claimed as wash.

At 375-default live phases, +8 lies over column-4 ceiling badge. At 430-default live phases, the accounting line crosses badge 4. Full before/after frames make the badge identity clear. This prevents whole-composition acceptance; no claim is made that Goal7 introduced the overlap without a matched fixture baseline.

All ten AX5 frames are star-bearing, but initial versus live placement changes and the lower guide/footer are outside the viewport. The capture waits sceneReady rather than stable common placement. These stills cannot prove complete-reader/footer or ceiling-badge clearance; the cause and production extent require responsible-owner verification, not an inferred product or performance diagnosis.
All ten isolated cases visually match their intended source/exclusion/absence roles. They do not contain an actual HUD or guide and therefore cannot establish real whole-screen clearance.

baselineBoundary.comparisonLimit: Accepted Goal6 native Ribbon Full Board +15000/+30000 phase stills are a different route/history from this hosted survival +8. No matched numerical or same-phase improvement claim is drawn across those fixtures.
